meas:
001||Alaska|Ballot Measure 2|IndISS|Elections & voting|Repeal the top-four ranked-choice voting (RCV) system that was adopted in 2020.||
002||Alaska|Ballot Measure 3|IndISS|Elections & voting|Amend state law to provide that "Only a person who is a citizen of the United States" may vote in any election.||
003||Alabama|Amendment 1|LRCA|Government & courts|Require the office of lieutenant governor to be filled by election if a vacancy occurs more than 60 days before the next general election.||
004||Alabama|Amendment 2|LRCA|Education|Establish a process for consolidating two or more county school districts.||
005||Alabama|Amendment 3|LRCA|Education|Require public schools to conduct the pledge of allegiance each day, and allow student-led prayer to be conducted.||
006||Alabama|Amendment 4|LRCA|Education|Require all public schools to broadcast or arrange for the performance of the first stanza of the Star-Spangled Banner at least once per week.||
007||Arkansas|Issue 1|LRCA|Elections & voting|Provide that "Only a citizen of the United States ... may vote in an election in this state".||
008||Arkansas|Issue 2|LRCA|Firearms|Provide that the right to keep and bear arms is "a natural, fundamental, and individual right that shall not be infringed".||
009||Arkansas|Issue 3|LRCA|Labor & economy|Allow the legislature to create programs, including Economic Development Districts, and make loans and grants of public money to develop the state economy.||
010||Arkansas|Issue 4|LRSS|Bonds & spending|Authorize the Arkansas Natural Resources Commission to issue up to $500 million in general obligation bonds to fund water-related infrastructure projects including water treatment and transportation, waste disposal, pollution abatement, drainage, irrigation, flood control, and wetlands and aquatic resources infrastructure.||
011||Arizona|Proposition 141|LRCA|Taxes|Prohibit the government from imposing taxes or fees based on vehicle miles traveled and from enacting rules to monitor or limit vehicle miles traveled without the person’s consent.||
012||Arizona|Proposition 142|LRCA|Civil rights|Prohibit the government from requiring an individual to endorse preferential treatment toward or discrimination against an individual on the basis of race or ethnicity.||
013||Arizona|Proposition 144|LRCA|Elections & voting|Make a number of changes to the state's election laws, including specifying that only citizens may vote in any Arizona election and requiring voters to show a government-issued ID to cast a ballot.||
014||Arizona|Proposition 316|LRSS|Taxes|Prohibit local government from imposing or increasing a tax on the sale of food items without voter approval and cap the tax rate at 2%.||
015||Arizona|Proposition 317|LRSS|Criminal justice|Declare drug cartels to be terrorist organizations.||
016||Arizona|Proposition 318|LRSS|LGBTQ & gender|Prohibit schools and athletic associations from allowing a student, athlete, employee, or other individual from using a restroom, locker room, shower room, or other private space that is not designated for their sex.||
017||Arizona|Proposition 319|LRSS|Criminal justice|Prohibit the government from using traffic photo enforcement systems without voter approval.||
018||Arizona|Proposition 320|LRSS|Education|Require certain school districts to spend at least 60% of their budget on direct instructional expenses.||
019||California|Proposition 1|BI|Bonds & spending|Issue $11.25 billion in bonds to fund Multifamily Housing Program, CalVet Home Loan Program, and youth housing.||A No vote opposes issuing these bonds.
020||California|Proposition 2|LRCA|Bonds & spending|Increase the Budget Stabilization Account (BSA) cap from 10% of general fund revenue to 20% and excluding deposits into the BSA from the Gann Limit.||
021||California|Proposition 37|CISS|Housing|Establish a second mortgage homebuyer program for qualified homebuyers on qualifying homes and issue $25 billion in bonds to fund the program.||
022||California|Proposition 38|CISS|Bonds & spending|Issue $8.4 billion in general obligation bonds to fund immunology and immunotherapy research.||
023||California|Proposition 39|CICA|Elections & voting|Require voters to present government-issued identification when casting ballots and require election officials to use government data to confirm voter citizenship and report verification rates.||
024||California|Proposition 3|CICA|Taxes|Renew the additional income taxes enacted with the approval of Proposition 30 in 2012 that fund education and early childhood programs.||
025||California|Proposition 40|CICA/SS|Taxes|Levy a one-time 5% tax on the accumulated wealth of taxpayers and trusts with covered assets valued over $1 billion to fund state health care programs, food assistance programs, and public education.||
026||California|Proposition 41|CICA|Taxes|Require state laws or ballot initiatives levying a new special tax enacted after January 1, 2026 to require the government entities or departments receiving revenue from the new tax to eliminate their lowest-performing programs and reinvest those savings in higher-performing programs.||
027||California|Proposition 42|CICA|Taxes|Prohibit the enactment of new taxes after January 1, 2026 on ownership or accumulation of retirement holdings, individually-owned assets, and other forms of personal savings.||
028||California|Proposition 43|LRCA|Taxes|Require two-thirds vote by electorate to enact, extend, or increase local special tax initiatives and prohibit local governments and ballot initiatives from enacting ad valorem property taxes except those authorized elsewhere in the state constitution.||
029||California|Proposition 44|CISS|Health|Prohibit healthcare clinics, specifically federally-qualified health centers and related organizations, from spending less than 90% of their annual revenue on mission-related purposes.||
030||California|Proposition 45|CISS|Housing|Establish timelines for local and state agencies to review plans and solicit public comment for essential projects, such as housing, improvements to water supply, transportation, energy, and facilities for health and public safety.||
031||California|Proposition 4|LRSS|Elections & voting|Allow the state and local governments to create programs that provide candidates with public funds under spending limits and eligibility rules.||
032||California|Proposition 5|LRCA|Elections & voting|Eliminate the successor election when a state officer is recalled, thereby leaving the office vacant until it is filled according to state law.||
033||Colorado|Amendment 81|CICA|Criminal justice|Require law enforcement to notify the U.S. Department of Homeland Security when a person is charged with a crime of violence or has a prior felony conviction and the person’s immigration status cannot be determined.||
034||Colorado|Amendment 82|CICA|Environment & natural resources|Provide a constitutional right for consumers to purchase natural gas for cooking or heating in homes and businesses and for distributors and utilities to sell natural gas for those purposes.||
035||Colorado|Amendment 83|CICA|Environment & natural resources|Establish a right to hunt, fish, and take fish and wildlife in the state constitution, through traditional methods, and allow the state legislature and executive agencies to regulate it.||
036||Colorado|Amendment 84|CICA|Elections & voting|Require voters casting ballots by mail to place their signature and some form of real ID on their ballot.||
037||Colorado|Amendment 85|CICA|Elections & voting|Require ballot questions to be in plain language, at no more than an eighth-grade reading level.||
038||Colorado|Amendment 86|CICA|Elections & voting|Require congressional maps drawn in 2028 to be approved by both a nonpolitical commission and the state supreme court.||
039||Colorado|Amendment 87|CICA/SS|Taxes|Establish a graduated income tax within the state.||
040||Colorado|Proposition 132|CISS|Criminal justice|Increase penalties for fentanyl-related felonies, require treatment for certain drug offenses, and limit sentencing exceptions in fentanyl-related crimes that cause another person’s death.||
041||Colorado|Proposition 133|CISS|Criminal justice|Require life in prison without parole or release for persons convicted of human trafficking a child for sexual servitude.||
042||Colorado|Proposition 134|CISS|LGBTQ & gender|Require all K-12 and collegiate school sports teams to be separated based on biological sex, unless the team is co-ed.||
043||Colorado|Proposition 135|CISS|LGBTQ & gender|Prohibit healthcare professionals from providing surgeries to persons under age 18 for the purpose of “treatment in response to a minor’s perception of sex or gender”.||
044||Colorado|Proposition 136|CISS|Taxes|Establish a 4.4% cap on individual and corporate income tax rates.||
045||Colorado|Proposition 137|CISS|Environment & natural resources|Allow the state to retain and spend sales tax revenue from sporting goods and equipment for water, land, forest, wildfire prevention, and outdoor recreation purposes.||
046||Colorado|Proposition NN|LRSS|Bonds & spending|Increase TABOR cap and use surplus funds for K-12 education expenses.||
047||Florida|Amendment 1|LRCA|Bonds & spending|Increase the amount of funds that may be retained in the budget stabilization fund from 10% to 25% of net general revenue among other changes.||
048||Florida|Amendment 2|LRCA|Taxes|Exempt agricultural-related tangible personal property, such as farm equipment or tools, from property taxes.||
049||Florida|Amendment 3|LRCA|Taxes|Increase the homestead tax exemption, decrease the cap on how much the assessed value of non-homestead properties can increase, and limit how municipalities can spend property tax revenue.||
050||Georgia|Amendment 1|LRCA|Taxes|Increase the maximum acreage of agricultural and timber property that can be classified as bona fide conservation use property, which is taxed at 40% of the land's value, from 2,000 acres to 4,000 acres.||
051||Georgia|Amendment 2|LRCA|Elections & voting|Require that probate judges be elected on a nonpartisan basis.||
052||Georgia|Amendment 3|LRCA|Bonds & spending|Allow the state legislature to create and dedicate revenue to a fund titled the Georgia Next Generation 9-1-1 Fund.||
053||Hawaii|Question 1|LRCA|Government & courts|Increase the timeframe for the Senate to consider and act on appointments of judges and justices from 30 days to 60 days for appointments made between April 1 and December 31 when the Senate is not in regular session or is soon to adjourn the regular session.||
054||Hawaii|Question 2|LRCA|Bonds & spending|Authorize the state legislature to empower the counties and municipalities of the state to issue housing infrastructure growth bonds for specified public works, public improvements, and community development.||
055||Iowa|Amendment 1|LRCA|Taxes|Require a two-thirds vote of both legislative chambers to pass a bill that would increase the individual or corporate income tax rate.||
056||Idaho|HJR 4|LRCA|Criminal justice|Provide that only the state legislature has the authority to legalize marijuana, narcotics, or other psychoactive substances.||
057||Idaho|HJR 6|LRCA|Government & courts|Add constitutional language designating English as the official language of Idaho.||
058||Idaho|Official State Gun Question|LRAQ|Firearms|Ask voters to choose the official state gun of Idaho.||
059||Idaho|Proposition 1|CISS|Abortion & reproductive rights|Provide, in statute, that people have a right to reproductive freedom and privacy, defined as "the right to make and carry out one’s own reproductive decisions".||
060||Indiana|Public Question 1|LRCA|Criminal justice|Provide for the denial of bail when the accused is found to pose a substantial risk to another person.||
061||Indiana|Public Question 2|LRCA|Government & courts|Require city and town court judges to reside in either the county where the court is located or the bordering county closest to the court.||
062||Kansas|Citizenship Voting Requirement Amendment|LRCA|Elections & voting|Amend the state constitution to state that only a citizen of the United States is eligible to vote.||
063||Kentucky|Limit Governor's Pardon Power and Commutations Near General Election Amendment|LRCA|Government & courts|Prohibit the governor from issuing a pardon or commuting a sentence 60 days prior to the gubernatorial election and until after the fifth Tuesday succeeding the election.||
064||Louisiana|Amendment 10|LRCA|Taxes|Authorize a tax exemption for derelict or blighted property that has been rehabilitated.||
065||Louisiana|Amendment 1|LRCA|Taxes|Allow the surviving spouse of a disabled veteran to transfer the homestead property tax exemption one time to a new homestead.||
066||Louisiana|Amendment 2|LRCA|Taxes|Authorize taxing authorities to levy a millage at a rate above the rate set by the previous year's assessment of the maximum amount of taxable property within each parish, but below the maximum permitted by the state constitution.||
067||Louisiana|Amendment 3|LRCA|Criminal justice|Prohibit post-conviction bail for a defendant who is convicted of an aggravated offense against a victim who is a minor.||
068||Louisiana|Amendment 4|LRCA|Government & courts|Change the gubernatorial term limit from two consecutive terms to a lifetime maximum of two terms.||
069||Louisiana|Amendment 5|LRCA|Bonds & spending|Remove the requirement that a state retirement system receiving nonrecurring state funds apply those funds to its oldest outstanding unfunded accrued liability first.||
070||Louisiana|Amendment 6|LRCA|Taxes|Authorize a property tax exemption up to $30,000 of assessed property value, increasing with age, from taxation for homeowners 65 and older who qualify for the income-based assessment freeze.||
071||Louisiana|Amendment 7|LRCA|Environment & natural resources|Authorize the use of public funds for the maintenance of drinking water utility services lines affected by hazardous materials on property owned by utility customers.||
072||Louisiana|Amendment 8|LRCA|Other|Prohibit expropriation of property by foreign adversaries or agents of a foreign adversary, as defined by law.||
073||Louisiana|Amendment 9|LRCA|Taxes|Raise the income limit to qualify for the property tax special assessment level from $100,000 to $150,000.||
074||Massachusetts|Question 1|IndISS|Government & courts|Make records held by the state legislature and the governor's office public records.||
075||Massachusetts|Question 2|IndISS|Labor & economy|Permit employees of the Committee for Public Counsel Services (CPCS) to participate in collective bargaining practices.||
076||Massachusetts|Question 3|IndISS|Elections & voting|Eliminate political party primaries for state elections and create a single primary where candidates are listed regardless of their political party.||
077||Massachusetts|Question 4|IndISS|Elections & voting|Provide for same-day voter registration.||
078||Massachusetts|Question 5|IndISS|Taxes|Change the limit of how much revenue the state can collect in a given year.||
079||Massachusetts|Question 6|IndISS|Bonds & spending|Create a fund for state money, titled the Nature for All Fund, that would be used to further efforts of nature conservation.||
080||Massachusetts|Question 7|IndISS|Housing|Require cities and towns to allow single-family homes on residentially zoned lots that meet minimum standards of at least 5,000 square feet in area.||
081||Massachusetts|Question 8|IndISS|Criminal justice|Repeal laws that permit the sale of recreational marijuana and the personal cultivation of cannabis in homes.||
082||Massachusetts|Question 9|VR|Firearms|Uphold the legislation, An Act Modernizing Firearm Laws (H. 4885), passed in 2024.||
083||Maryland|Question 1|LRCA|Labor & economy|Require the budget submitted by the governor to provide for expenditures for wages, hours, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment provided by a memorandum of understanding that covers state employees and provides for statutory changes to collective bargaining for state employees, including requiring the selection of a neutral arbitrator and establishing a process of arbitration.||
084||Maryland|Question 2|LRCA|Government & courts|Allow the chair of the Commission on Judicial Disabilities to appoint former members to temporarily fill vacancies or allow the governor to appoint a substitute member or extend the term of an existing member.||
085||Maryland|Question 3|LRCA|Elections & voting|Provide that constitutional requirements for legislative districts apply only to state legislative districts and not to congressional districts.||
086||Michigan|Proposal 1|CCQ|Elections & voting|Asks voters whether to hold a state constitutional convention.|A Yes vote supports holding a constitutional convention.|A No vote opposes holding a constitutional convention.
087||Michigan|Proposal 2|CISS|Elections & voting|Prohibit certain organizations and individuals—such as regulated electric and gas utilities, contractors with over $250,000 annually in government contracts, and people and organizations with substantial connections to those utilities or contractors—from making direct or indirect contributions to those who run for office, and also provide further regulations for campaign finance laws and spending on political communications.||
088||Minnesota|Alter Investment and Distribution Policies for Permanent School Fund Amendment|LRCA|Bonds & spending|Change the administrative policies for investing and distributing the Minnesota Permanent School Fund.||
089||Missouri|Amendment 3|LRCA|Abortion & reproductive rights|Prohibit abortion in most cases, and prohibit gender transition procedures for minors under eighteen.||
090||Missouri|Amendment 6|CICA|Elections & voting|Prohibit the legislature from repealing or amending a citizen initiative unless at least 80% of both the House and Senate vote to refer a proposed change to the ballot, and voters then approve the change, prohibit the legislature from making changes to the citizen initiative and referendum process, among other changes.||
091||Missouri|Amendment 7|LRCA|Taxes|Create a permanent public endowment fund managed by the state to generate revenue, and use the earnings to eliminate state-imposed taxes when sufficient to replace them.||
092||Missouri|Amendment 8|LRCA|Elections & voting|Require the election of county sheriffs.||
093||Missouri|Proposition A|VR|Elections & voting|Uphold House Bill 1, which provided for new congressional districts ("yes" upholds, and "no" repeals).||
094||Montana|CI-132|CICA|Elections & voting|Add a new section to the Montana Constitution to require that all judicial elections are nonpartisan.||
095||Montana|CI-133|CICA|Elections & voting|Add the power of initiative and referendum to the state's Declaration of Rights.||
096||Montana|I-194|CISS|Elections & voting|Prohibit artificial persons, as defined in the initiative, from contributing to campaigns, ballot measure elections, or political parties.||
097||North Carolina|Property Tax Levy Limit Amendment|LRCA|Taxes|Require the state legislature to pass laws limiting the amount that property taxes may increase.||
098||North Carolina|Reduce Income Tax Rate Cap from 7% to 3.5% Amendment|LRCA|Taxes|Reduce the maximum allowable income tax rate from 7% to 3.5%.||
099||North Carolina|Require Voter Identification Amendment|LRCA|Elections & voting|Require photographic identification to vote for all voters, not just those voting in person.||
100||North Dakota|Constitutional Measure 1|LRCA|Elections & voting|Require constitutional amendments to receive a 60% supermajority vote to be adopted.||
101||North Dakota|Constitutional Measure 2|CICA|Education|Require public schools to provide one free breakfast and one free lunch to students.||
102||Nebraska|Constitutional Amendment 1|LRCA|Government & courts|Change the legislative term limit from two consecutive four-year terms to three.||
103||Nebraska|Initiative Measure 440|CICA|Gambling|Authorize laws to govern sports betting.||
104||Nebraska|Initiative Measure 441|CISS|Gambling|Authorize online sports betting in the state and authorize the state gaming commission to adopt rules and regulations governing the gaming operators.||
105||Nebraska|Initiative Measure 442|CICA|LGBTQ & gender|Require schools designate sports team as male, female, or co-ed and prohibit male participation on female sports teams.||
106||New Hampshire|Eliminate Office of Register of Probate Amendment|LRCA|Government & courts|Eliminate the office of the register of probate.||
107||New Mexico|Bond Question 1|BI|Bonds & spending|Authorize $30 million in general obligation bonds for senior citizen facility improvement, construction, and equipment acquisition projects, funded by a statewide property tax.||A No vote opposes issuing these bonds.
108||New Mexico|Bond Question 2|BI|Bonds & spending|Authorize up to $20 million in general obligation bonds for academic, public school, tribal, and public library resource acquisitions, funded by a statewide property tax.||A No vote opposes issuing these bonds.
109||New Mexico|Bond Question 3|BI|Bonds & spending|Authorize up to $230 million in general obligation bonds for capital improvements and acquisitions at higher education institutions, special schools, and tribal schools, funded by a statewide property tax.||A No vote opposes issuing these bonds.
110||New Mexico|Constitutional Amendment 1|LRCA|Government & courts|Require bills to become law if the governor does not sign or veto them within the required timeframe, eliminating the governor's pocket veto.||
111||New Mexico|Constitutional Amendment 2|LRCA|Elections & voting|Repeal the constitutional provision requiring that school elections be held at different times from partisan elections.||
112||New Mexico|Constitutional Amendment 3|LRCA|Education|Make changes to the Board of Regents, including establishing nominating committees to provide lists of candidates, provide that student members are appointed from a list provided by student governing body, and prohibit non-student members from changing political party 12 months preceding appointment.||
113||New Mexico|Constitutional Amendment 4|LRCA|Government & courts|Establish a salary for state legislators equal to the annual median household income of the state.||
114||Nevada|Question 6|CICA|Abortion & reproductive rights|Provide for a state constitutional right to abortion before fetal viability.||
115||Nevada|Question 7|CICA|Elections & voting|Require voters to present photo identification when voting in person or to provide the last four digits of their driver’s license or Social Security number when voting by mail.||
116||Ohio|Issue 3|LRCA|Elections & voting|Require photo ID to vote.||
117||Oklahoma|State Question 845|LRCA|Government & courts|Make changes to the judicial nominating commission, including that appointments shall be made according to current congressional districts.||
118||Oklahoma|State Question 847|LRCA|Taxes|Reduce the annual growth limit of the calculated fair cash value of property.||
119||Rhode Island|Question 1|BI|Bonds & spending|Issue $275 million in bonds to fund the construction and improvement of higher education facilities.||A No vote opposes issuing these bonds.
120||Rhode Island|Question 2|BI|Bonds & spending|Issue $120 million in bonds to fund the construction and development of affordable housing projects.||A No vote opposes issuing these bonds.
121||Rhode Island|Question 3|BI|Bonds & spending|Issue $100 million in bonds to fund infrastructure and economic development projects.||A No vote opposes issuing these bonds.
122||Rhode Island|Question 4|BI|Bonds & spending|Issue $50 million in bonds to fund cultural and historical projects.||A No vote opposes issuing these bonds.
123||Rhode Island|Question 5|BI|Bonds & spending|Issue $55 million in bonds to fund environmental preservation and water infrastructure projects.||A No vote opposes issuing these bonds.
124||South Dakota|Constitutional Amendment I|LRCA|Health|Condition Medicaid expansion on federal funding remaining at least 90%.||
125||South Dakota|Constitutional Amendment J|LRCA|Elections & voting|Provide that "[an] individual who is not a citizen of the United States is disqualified from voting in any election or upon any question submitted to the voters".||
126||South Dakota|Constitutional Amendment K|LRCA|Bonds & spending|Establish an unclaimed property trust fund.||
127||South Dakota|Constitutional Amendment L|LRCA|Elections & voting|Require a 60% supermajority by voters to approve constitutional amendments.||
128||Tennessee|Amendment 1|LRCA|Criminal justice|Remove the right to bail for specified criminal offenses.||
129||Tennessee|Amendment 2|LRCA|Taxes|Prohibit the legislature from enacting taxes on property.||
130||Tennessee|Amendment 3|LRCA|Criminal justice|Amend the list of crime victims' rights in the constitution.||
131||Utah|Constitutional Amendment A|LRCA|Elections & voting|Require that constitutional amendments appearing on the ballot must be published for a period of 60 days.||
132||Utah|Constitutional Amendment B|LRCA|Taxes|Require a supermajority requirement of 60% by voters for citizen-initiated ballot measures that create new taxes, increase existing tax rates, or for a property tax.||
133||Virginia|Question 1|LRCA|Abortion & reproductive rights|Provide a state constitutional right to reproductive freedom, defined as "the right to make and effectuate one's own decisions about all matters related to one's pregnancy".||

136||Vermont|Proposal 3|LRCA|Labor & economy|Establish a state constitutional right to organize or join a labor organization for the purpose of collective bargaining.||
137||Vermont|Proposal 4|LRCA|Civil rights|Prohibit the denial of rights to an individual based on their race, ethnicity, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or national origin.||
138||Washington|Initiative 1|IndISS|Education|Re-enact Initiative to the Legislature 2081 (2024), related to parental rights to review educational materials, receive specific notifications, and opt their children out of sexual health education.||
139||Washington|Initiative 638|IndISS|LGBTQ & gender|Require school and voluntary nonprofit athletics to prohibit biologically male students from competing with and against biologically female students.||
140||Washington|Initiative 645|CISS|Taxes|Repeal the tax on household income over $1 million and prohibit state and local taxes on individual income.||
141||Wisconsin|Question 1|LRCA|Government & courts|Prohibit the governor from using the partial veto to create or increase any tax or fee.||
142||Wisconsin|Question 2|LRCA|Civil rights|Prohibit the government from closing gatherings at places of worship during declared emergencies, including public health emergencies.||
143||Wisconsin|Question 3|LRCA|Civil rights|Prohibit the government from discriminating or granting preferential treatment based on race, sex, color, ethnicity, or national origin.||
144||West Virginia|Citizenship Voting Requirement Amendment|LRCA|Elections & voting|Amend the constitution to state that only citizens may vote in elections.||

001.original: Repeal the top-four ranked-choice voting (RCV) system that was adopted in 2020.
001.nb: Fjerne ordningen med felles primærvalg og rangert stemmegivning som ble vedtatt i 2020.

002.original: Amend state law to provide that "Only a person who is a citizen of the United States" may vote in any election.
002.nb: Fastslå i loven at bare amerikanske statsborgere kan stemme i valg.

003.original: Require the office of lieutenant governor to be filled by election if a vacancy occurs more than 60 days before the next general election.
003.nb: Kreve valg av ny viseguvernør hvis stillingen blir ledig mer enn 60 dager før neste ordinære valg.

004.original: Establish a process for consolidating two or more county school districts.
004.nb: Opprette en prosess for å slå sammen skoledistrikter.

005.original: Require public schools to conduct the pledge of allegiance each day, and allow student-led prayer to be conducted.
005.nb: Kreve daglig troskapsløfte i offentlige skoler og tillate elevledet bønn.

006.original: Require all public schools to broadcast or arrange for the performance of the first stanza of the Star-Spangled Banner at least once per week.
006.nb: Kreve at offentlige skoler fremfører eller spiller første vers av nasjonalsangen minst ukentlig.

007.original: Provide that "Only a citizen of the United States ... may vote in an election in this state".
007.nb: Fastslå at bare amerikanske statsborgere kan stemme i delstatens valg.

008.original: Provide that the right to keep and bear arms is "a natural, fundamental, and individual right that shall not be infringed".
008.nb: Grunnlovsfeste retten til å eie og bære våpen som en grunnleggende individuell rettighet.

009.original: Allow the legislature to create programs, including Economic Development Districts, and make loans and grants of public money to develop the state economy.
009.nb: Tillate offentlige lån, tilskudd og programmer for økonomisk utvikling.

010.original: Authorize the Arkansas Natural Resources Commission to issue up to $500 million in general obligation bonds to fund water-related infrastructure projects including water treatment and transportation, waste disposal, pollution abatement, drainage, irrigation, flood control, and wetlands and aquatic resources infrastructure.
010.nb: Tillate lån på opptil 500 millioner dollar til vannrelatert infrastruktur.

011.original: Prohibit the government from imposing taxes or fees based on vehicle miles traveled and from enacting rules to monitor or limit vehicle miles traveled without the person’s consent.
011.nb: Forby kjørelengdebaserte skatter og avgifter, og overvåking eller begrensning av kjørelengde uten samtykke.

012.original: Prohibit the government from requiring an individual to endorse preferential treatment toward or discrimination against an individual on the basis of race or ethnicity.
012.nb: Forby myndighetene å kreve at noen støtter forskjellsbehandling basert på rase eller etnisitet.

013.original: Make a number of changes to the state's election laws, including specifying that only citizens may vote in any Arizona election and requiring voters to show a government-issued ID to cast a ballot.
013.nb: Endre valglovene, blant annet med krav om statsborgerskap og offentlig utstedt legitimasjon.

014.original: Prohibit local government from imposing or increasing a tax on the sale of food items without voter approval and cap the tax rate at 2%.
014.nb: Kreve velgergodkjenning av nye eller økte lokale matskatter og sette et tak på 2 prosent.

015.original: Declare drug cartels to be terrorist organizations.

016.original: Prohibit schools and athletic associations from allowing a student, athlete, employee, or other individual from using a restroom, locker room, shower room, or other private space that is not designated for their sex.
016.nb: Kreve at skoler og idrettsorganisasjoner begrenser tilgang til toaletter og garderober etter kjønn.

017.original: Prohibit the government from using traffic photo enforcement systems without voter approval.
017.nb: Kreve velgergodkjenning av automatisk trafikkontroll med kamera.

018.original: Require certain school districts to spend at least 60% of their budget on direct instructional expenses.
018.nb: Kreve at enkelte skoledistrikter bruker minst 60 prosent av budsjettet direkte på undervisning.

019.original: Issue $11.25 billion in bonds to fund Multifamily Housing Program, CalVet Home Loan Program, and youth housing.
019.nb: Låne 11,25 milliarder dollar til boligprogrammer for blant andre veteraner og unge.

020.original: Increase the Budget Stabilization Account (BSA) cap from 10% of general fund revenue to 20% and excluding deposits into the BSA from the Gann Limit.
020.nb: Øke taket for delstatens budsjettreserve fra 10 til 20 prosent og unnta innskudd fra utgiftsgrensen.

021.original: Establish a second mortgage homebuyer program for qualified homebuyers on qualifying homes and issue $25 billion in bonds to fund the program.
021.nb: Opprette et boliglånsprogram og låne 25 milliarder dollar til ordningen.

022.original: Issue $8.4 billion in general obligation bonds to fund immunology and immunotherapy research.
022.nb: Låne 8,4 milliarder dollar til forskning på immunologi og immunterapi.

023.original: Require voters to present government-issued identification when casting ballots and require election officials to use government data to confirm voter citizenship and report verification rates.
023.nb: Kreve offentlig utstedt legitimasjon ved valg og kontroll av velgernes statsborgerskap mot offentlige data.

024.original: Renew the additional income taxes enacted with the approval of Proposition 30 in 2012 that fund education and early childhood programs.
024.nb: Videreføre ekstra inntektsskatter til utdanning og tilbud for små barn.

025.original: Levy a one-time 5% tax on the accumulated wealth of taxpayers and trusts with covered assets valued over $1 billion to fund state health care programs, food assistance programs, and public education.
025.nb: Innføre en engangsskatt på 5 prosent på formuer over én milliard dollar til helse, mathjelp og utdanning.

026.original: Require state laws or ballot initiatives levying a new special tax enacted after January 1, 2026 to require the government entities or departments receiving revenue from the new tax to eliminate their lowest-performing programs and reinvest those savings in higher-performing programs.
026.nb: Kreve at mottakere av nye særskatter avvikler de svakeste programmene og omfordeler innsparingene.

027.original: Prohibit the enactment of new taxes after January 1, 2026 on ownership or accumulation of retirement holdings, individually-owned assets, and other forms of personal savings.
027.nb: Forby nye skatter på pensjonsmidler, personlig eide eiendeler og annen personlig sparing etter 1. januar 2026.

028.original: Require two-thirds vote by electorate to enact, extend, or increase local special tax initiatives and prohibit local governments and ballot initiatives from enacting ad valorem property taxes except those authorized elsewhere in the state constitution.
028.nb: Kreve to tredels flertall for lokale særskatter og begrense adgangen til eiendomsskatt.

029.original: Prohibit healthcare clinics, specifically federally-qualified health centers and related organizations, from spending less than 90% of their annual revenue on mission-related purposes.
029.nb: Kreve at visse helsesentre bruker minst 90 prosent av inntektene på formålet sitt.

030.original: Establish timelines for local and state agencies to review plans and solicit public comment for essential projects, such as housing, improvements to water supply, transportation, energy, and facilities for health and public safety.
030.nb: Innføre tidsfrister for behandling og offentlig høring av viktige bolig- og infrastrukturprosjekter.

031.original: Allow the state and local governments to create programs that provide candidates with public funds under spending limits and eligibility rules.
031.nb: Tillate offentlig valgkampfinansiering med krav til kandidater og utgiftsgrenser.

032.original: Eliminate the successor election when a state officer is recalled, thereby leaving the office vacant until it is filled according to state law.
032.nb: Fjerne eget etterfølgervalg når en folkevalgt blir avsatt gjennom tilbakekallingsvalg.

033.original: Require law enforcement to notify the U.S. Department of Homeland Security when a person is charged with a crime of violence or has a prior felony conviction and the person’s immigration status cannot be determined.
033.nb: Kreve varsling av føderale myndigheter ved visse alvorlige straffesaker når innvandringsstatus er ukjent.

034.original: Provide a constitutional right for consumers to purchase natural gas for cooking or heating in homes and businesses and for distributors and utilities to sell natural gas for those purposes.
034.nb: Grunnlovsfeste retten til å kjøpe og selge naturgass til matlaging og oppvarming.

035.original: Establish a right to hunt, fish, and take fish and wildlife in the state constitution, through traditional methods, and allow the state legislature and executive agencies to regulate it.
035.nb: Grunnlovsfeste retten til jakt og fiske med tradisjonelle metoder, underlagt offentlig regulering.

036.original: Require voters casting ballots by mail to place their signature and some form of real ID on their ballot.
036.nb: Kreve signatur og identitetsdokumentasjon ved poststemming.

037.original: Require ballot questions to be in plain language, at no more than an eighth-grade reading level.
037.nb: Kreve enkelt språk i folkeavstemningsspørsmål, forståelig på ungdomsskolenivå.

038.original: Require congressional maps drawn in 2028 to be approved by both a nonpolitical commission and the state supreme court.
038.nb: Kreve at kongressdistriktene som tegnes i 2028 godkjennes av både en upolitisk kommisjon og delstatens høyesterett.

039.original: Establish a graduated income tax within the state.

040.original: Increase penalties for fentanyl-related felonies, require treatment for certain drug offenses, and limit sentencing exceptions in fentanyl-related crimes that cause another person’s death.
040.nb: Skjerpe straffer for fentanyllovbrudd, kreve behandling i enkelte narkotikasaker og begrense straffeunntak ved dødsfall.

041.original: Require life in prison without parole or release for persons convicted of human trafficking a child for sexual servitude.
041.nb: Kreve livstid uten løslatelse for menneskehandel med barn til seksuell utnyttelse.

042.original: Require all K-12 and collegiate school sports teams to be separated based on biological sex, unless the team is co-ed.
042.nb: Kreve kjønnsdelte idrettslag i skole og høyere utdanning, med unntak for blandede lag.

043.original: Prohibit healthcare professionals from providing surgeries to persons under age 18 for the purpose of “treatment in response to a minor’s perception of sex or gender”.
043.nb: Forby helsepersonell å utføre kjønnsbekreftende kirurgi på personer under 18 år.

044.original: Establish a 4.4% cap on individual and corporate income tax rates.
044.nb: Sette et tak på 4,4 prosent for inntektsskatt for personer og selskaper.

045.original: Allow the state to retain and spend sales tax revenue from sporting goods and equipment for water, land, forest, wildfire prevention, and outdoor recreation purposes.
045.nb: Tillate bruk av salgsavgifter på sportsutstyr til natur, vann, skogbrannforebygging og friluftsliv.

046.original: Increase TABOR cap and use surplus funds for K-12 education expenses.
046.nb: Heve delstatens inntektstak etter TABOR-reglene og bruke overskudd på skoleutgifter.

047.original: Increase the amount of funds that may be retained in the budget stabilization fund from 10% to 25% of net general revenue among other changes.
047.nb: Øke taket for budsjettreserven fra 10 til 25 prosent av netto ordinære inntekter, samt andre endringer.

048.original: Exempt agricultural-related tangible personal property, such as farm equipment or tools, from property taxes.
048.nb: Frita landbruksutstyr og andre løse driftsmidler i landbruket fra eiendomsskatt.

049.original: Increase the homestead tax exemption, decrease the cap on how much the assessed value of non-homestead properties can increase, and limit how municipalities can spend property tax revenue.
049.nb: Øke boligfradraget, begrense verdsettelsesvekst for andre eiendommer og kommunenes bruk av skatteinntekter.

050.original: Increase the maximum acreage of agricultural and timber property that can be classified as bona fide conservation use property, which is taxed at 40% of the land's value, from 2,000 acres to 4,000 acres.
050.nb: Doble arealgrensen for landbruks- og skogeiendom som kan få gunstig skatteverdsettelse.

051.original: Require that probate judges be elected on a nonpartisan basis.
051.nb: Kreve at skiftedommere velges uten partitilknytning.

052.original: Allow the state legislature to create and dedicate revenue to a fund titled the Georgia Next Generation 9-1-1 Fund.
052.nb: Tillate et øremerket fond for neste generasjons nødmeldetjeneste 911.

053.original: Increase the timeframe for the Senate to consider and act on appointments of judges and justices from 30 days to 60 days for appointments made between April 1 and December 31 when the Senate is not in regular session or is soon to adjourn the regular session.
053.nb: Forlenge Senatets frist for enkelte dommerutnevnelser fra 30 til 60 dager utenfor ordinær sesjon.

054.original: Authorize the state legislature to empower the counties and municipalities of the state to issue housing infrastructure growth bonds for specified public works, public improvements, and community development.
054.nb: Tillate lokale lån til boliginfrastruktur og bestemte offentlige utviklingsprosjekter.

055.original: Require a two-thirds vote of both legislative chambers to pass a bill that would increase the individual or corporate income tax rate.
055.nb: Kreve to tredels flertall i begge kamre for å øke inntektsskatten for personer eller selskaper.

056.original: Provide that only the state legislature has the authority to legalize marijuana, narcotics, or other psychoactive substances.
056.nb: Gi delstatsforsamlingen enerett til å legalisere cannabis, narkotika og andre psykoaktive stoffer.

057.original: Add constitutional language designating English as the official language of Idaho.
057.nb: Grunnlovsfeste engelsk som Idahos offisielle språk.

058.original: Ask voters to choose the official state gun of Idaho.
058.nb: La velgerne velge Idahos offisielle delstatsvåpen.

059.original: Provide, in statute, that people have a right to reproductive freedom and privacy, defined as "the right to make and carry out one’s own reproductive decisions".
059.nb: Lovfeste retten til reproduktiv frihet og privatliv, inkludert egne reproduktive beslutninger.

060.original: Provide for the denial of bail when the accused is found to pose a substantial risk to another person.
060.nb: Tillate nektelse av kausjon når den tiltalte utgjør en betydelig fare for andre.

061.original: Require city and town court judges to reside in either the county where the court is located or the bordering county closest to the court.
061.nb: Kreve at lokale dommere bor i rettens fylke eller nærmeste nabofylke.

062.original: Amend the state constitution to state that only a citizen of the United States is eligible to vote.
062.nb: Grunnlovsfeste at bare amerikanske statsborgere har stemmerett.

063.original: Prohibit the governor from issuing a pardon or commuting a sentence 60 days prior to the gubernatorial election and until after the fifth Tuesday succeeding the election.
063.nb: Begrense guvernørens benådninger og straffenedsettelser fra 60 dager før guvernørvalg til femte tirsdag etter valget.

064.original: Authorize a tax exemption for derelict or blighted property that has been rehabilitated.
064.nb: Tillate skattefritak for rehabiliterte, forfalne eiendommer.

065.original: Allow the surviving spouse of a disabled veteran to transfer the homestead property tax exemption one time to a new homestead.
065.nb: Tillate at gjenlevende ektefelle etter en funksjonshemmet veteran flytter boligskattefritaket én gang.

066.original: Authorize taxing authorities to levy a millage at a rate above the rate set by the previous year's assessment of the maximum amount of taxable property within each parish, but below the maximum permitted by the state constitution.
066.nb: Gi skattemyndigheter større rom til å fastsette eiendomsskattesatser innenfor grunnlovens maksimum.

067.original: Prohibit post-conviction bail for a defendant who is convicted of an aggravated offense against a victim who is a minor.
067.nb: Forby kausjon etter dom for grove lovbrudd mot mindreårige.

068.original: Change the gubernatorial term limit from two consecutive terms to a lifetime maximum of two terms.
068.nb: Endre guvernørens periodebegrensning fra to sammenhengende perioder til to perioder totalt.

069.original: Remove the requirement that a state retirement system receiving nonrecurring state funds apply those funds to its oldest outstanding unfunded accrued liability first.
069.nb: Fjerne kravet om at ekstraordinære tilskudd til offentlige pensjonsfond først dekker de eldste udekkede forpliktelsene.

070.original: Authorize a property tax exemption up to $30,000 of assessed property value, increasing with age, from taxation for homeowners 65 and older who qualify for the income-based assessment freeze.
070.nb: Tillate aldersgradert eiendomsskattefritak på opptil 30 000 dollar for kvalifiserte boligeiere fra 65 år.

071.original: Authorize the use of public funds for the maintenance of drinking water utility services lines affected by hazardous materials on property owned by utility customers.
071.nb: Tillate offentlige midler til vedlikehold av private drikkevannsledninger berørt av farlige stoffer.

072.original: Prohibit expropriation of property by foreign adversaries or agents of a foreign adversary, as defined by law.
072.nb: Forby ekspropriasjon utført av utenlandske motstandere eller deres representanter, slik loven definerer dem.

073.original: Raise the income limit to qualify for the property tax special assessment level from $100,000 to $150,000.
073.nb: Øke inntektsgrensen for særskilt eiendomsskatteverdsettelse fra 100 000 til 150 000 dollar.

074.original: Make records held by the state legislature and the governor's office public records.
074.nb: Gi offentlig innsyn i dokumenter hos delstatsforsamlingen og guvernørens kontor.

075.original: Permit employees of the Committee for Public Counsel Services (CPCS) to participate in collective bargaining practices.
075.nb: Gi ansatte i den offentlige rettshjelpstjenesten adgang til kollektive forhandlinger.

076.original: Eliminate political party primaries for state elections and create a single primary where candidates are listed regardless of their political party.
076.nb: Erstatte partienes primærvalg til delstatsverv med ett felles primærvalg.

078.original: Change the limit of how much revenue the state can collect in a given year.
078.nb: Endre grensen for hvor store inntekter delstaten kan kreve inn årlig.

079.original: Create a fund for state money, titled the Nature for All Fund, that would be used to further efforts of nature conservation.
079.nb: Opprette fondet Nature for All Fund til naturvern.

080.original: Require cities and towns to allow single-family homes on residentially zoned lots that meet minimum standards of at least 5,000 square feet in area.
080.nb: Kreve tillatelse til eneboliger på boligtomter som oppfyller minstekrav, blant annet minst 5 000 kvadratfot.

081.original: Repeal laws that permit the sale of recreational marijuana and the personal cultivation of cannabis in homes.
081.nb: Oppheve lovene som tillater salg av cannabis til rekreasjonsbruk og hjemmedyrking.

082.original: Uphold the legislation, An Act Modernizing Firearm Laws (H. 4885), passed in 2024.
082.nb: Opprettholde våpenloven fra 2024, An Act Modernizing Firearm Laws.

083.original: Require the budget submitted by the governor to provide for expenditures for wages, hours, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment provided by a memorandum of understanding that covers state employees and provides for statutory changes to collective bargaining for state employees, including requiring the selection of a neutral arbitrator and establishing a process of arbitration.
083.nb: Kreve budsjettdekning av avtalte arbeidsvilkår for delstatsansatte og innføre regler om nøytral voldgift.

084.original: Allow the chair of the Commission on Judicial Disabilities to appoint former members to temporarily fill vacancies or allow the governor to appoint a substitute member or extend the term of an existing member.
084.nb: Tillate midlertidige medlemmer og forlengede perioder i kommisjonen for dommertilsyn.

085.original: Provide that constitutional requirements for legislative districts apply only to state legislative districts and not to congressional districts.
085.nb: Begrense grunnlovens distriktskrav til delstatsvalg, slik at de ikke gjelder kongressdistrikter.

086.original: Asks voters whether to hold a state constitutional convention.

087.original: Prohibit certain organizations and individuals—such as regulated electric and gas utilities, contractors with over $250,000 annually in government contracts, and people and organizations with substantial connections to those utilities or contractors—from making direct or indirect contributions to those who run for office, and also provide further regulations for campaign finance laws and spending on political communications.
087.nb: Begrense politiske bidrag fra blant andre regulerte energiselskaper, store offentlige leverandører og tilknyttede aktører.

088.original: Change the administrative policies for investing and distributing the Minnesota Permanent School Fund.
088.nb: Endre reglene for investeringer og utdelinger fra delstatens permanente skolefond.

089.original: Prohibit abortion in most cases, and prohibit gender transition procedures for minors under eighteen.
089.nb: Forby abort i de fleste tilfeller og kjønnsbekreftende behandling for personer under 18 år.

090.original: Prohibit the legislature from repealing or amending a citizen initiative unless at least 80% of both the House and Senate vote to refer a proposed change to the ballot, and voters then approve the change, prohibit the legislature from making changes to the citizen initiative and referendum process, among other changes.
090.nb: Beskytte borgerinitiativer mot lovendringer uten 80 prosent flertall i begge kamre og ny velgergodkjenning.

091.original: Create a permanent public endowment fund managed by the state to generate revenue, and use the earnings to eliminate state-imposed taxes when sufficient to replace them.
091.nb: Opprette et varig offentlig fond og bruke avkastningen til å fjerne delstatsskatter når den dekker inntektstapet.

092.original: Require the election of county sheriffs.

093.original: Uphold House Bill 1, which provided for new congressional districts ("yes" upholds, and "no" repeals).
093.nb: Opprettholde loven om nye kongressdistrikter. Ja beholder kartet; nei opphever det.

094.original: Add a new section to the Montana Constitution to require that all judicial elections are nonpartisan.
094.nb: Grunnlovsfeste at alle dommervalg skal være uten partitilknytning.

095.original: Add the power of initiative and referendum to the state's Declaration of Rights.
095.nb: Ta retten til borgerinitiativ og folkeavstemning inn i delstatens rettighetserklæring.

096.original: Prohibit artificial persons, as defined in the initiative, from contributing to campaigns, ballot measure elections, or political parties.
096.nb: Forby juridiske personer, slik initiativet definerer dem, å gi bidrag til valgkamper, folkeavstemninger eller partier.

097.original: Require the state legislature to pass laws limiting the amount that property taxes may increase.
097.nb: Kreve lovfestede begrensninger på veksten i eiendomsskatten.

098.original: Reduce the maximum allowable income tax rate from 7% to 3.5%.
098.nb: Senke den høyeste tillatte inntektsskattesatsen fra 7 til 3,5 prosent.

099.original: Require photographic identification to vote for all voters, not just those voting in person.
099.nb: Kreve legitimasjon med bilde ved all stemmegivning, også utenfor valglokalet.

100.original: Require constitutional amendments to receive a 60% supermajority vote to be adopted.

101.original: Require public schools to provide one free breakfast and one free lunch to students.
101.nb: Kreve én gratis frokost og én gratis lunsj til elever i offentlige skoler.

102.original: Change the legislative term limit from two consecutive four-year terms to three.
102.nb: Øke grensen for sammenhengende fireårsperioder i delstatsforsamlingen fra to til tre.

103.original: Authorize laws to govern sports betting.

104.original: Authorize online sports betting in the state and authorize the state gaming commission to adopt rules and regulations governing the gaming operators.
104.nb: Tillate nettbaserte sportsveddemål og regulering gjennom delstatens spillkommisjon.

105.original: Require schools designate sports team as male, female, or co-ed and prohibit male participation on female sports teams.
105.nb: Kreve at skolelag merkes som gutte-, jente- eller blandede lag, og forby gutter å delta på jentelag.

106.original: Eliminate the office of the register of probate.
106.nb: Avvikle embetet som registerfører for skiftesaker.

107.original: Authorize $30 million in general obligation bonds for senior citizen facility improvement, construction, and equipment acquisition projects, funded by a statewide property tax.
107.nb: Låne 30 millioner dollar til bygg, utstyr og forbedringer ved eldresentre, finansiert med eiendomsskatt.

108.original: Authorize up to $20 million in general obligation bonds for academic, public school, tribal, and public library resource acquisitions, funded by a statewide property tax.
108.nb: Låne opptil 20 millioner dollar til bibliotekressurser, finansiert med eiendomsskatt.

109.original: Authorize up to $230 million in general obligation bonds for capital improvements and acquisitions at higher education institutions, special schools, and tribal schools, funded by a statewide property tax.
109.nb: Låne opptil 230 millioner dollar til høyere utdanning og særskilte skoler, finansiert med eiendomsskatt.

110.original: Require bills to become law if the governor does not sign or veto them within the required timeframe, eliminating the governor's pocket veto.
110.nb: La lovforslag tre i kraft hvis guvernøren verken signerer eller nedlegger veto innen fristen.

111.original: Repeal the constitutional provision requiring that school elections be held at different times from partisan elections.
111.nb: Oppheve kravet om at skolevalg skal holdes på andre tidspunkter enn partipolitiske valg.

112.original: Make changes to the Board of Regents, including establishing nominating committees to provide lists of candidates, provide that student members are appointed from a list provided by student governing body, and prohibit non-student members from changing political party 12 months preceding appointment.
112.nb: Endre utnevnelsesreglene for universitetsstyrer, med nominasjonskomiteer og særregler for studentmedlemmer.

113.original: Establish a salary for state legislators equal to the annual median household income of the state.
113.nb: Gi delstatsrepresentanter årslønn tilsvarende delstatens medianinntekt for husholdninger.

114.original: Provide for a state constitutional right to abortion before fetal viability.
114.nb: Grunnlovsfeste retten til abort frem til fosteret er levedyktig utenfor livmoren.

115.original: Require voters to present photo identification when voting in person or to provide the last four digits of their driver’s license or Social Security number when voting by mail.
115.nb: Kreve bilde-ID ved personlig stemmegivning og fire siste sifre i førerkort- eller personnummer ved poststemming.

116.nb: Kreve legitimasjon med bilde for å stemme.

117.original: Make changes to the judicial nominating commission, including that appointments shall be made according to current congressional districts.
117.nb: Endre reglene for dommernominasjonskommisjonen, blant annet utnevnelser etter dagens kongressdistrikter.

118.original: Reduce the annual growth limit of the calculated fair cash value of property.
118.nb: Senke grensen for årlig vekst i eiendommers beregnede markedsverdi.

119.original: Issue $275 million in bonds to fund the construction and improvement of higher education facilities.
119.nb: Låne 275 millioner dollar til bygg og forbedringer innen høyere utdanning.

120.original: Issue $120 million in bonds to fund the construction and development of affordable housing projects.
120.nb: Låne 120 millioner dollar til rimelige boliger.

121.original: Issue $100 million in bonds to fund infrastructure and economic development projects.
121.nb: Låne 100 millioner dollar til infrastruktur og økonomisk utvikling.

122.original: Issue $50 million in bonds to fund cultural and historical projects.
122.nb: Låne 50 millioner dollar til kultur- og historieprosjekter.

123.original: Issue $55 million in bonds to fund environmental preservation and water infrastructure projects.
123.nb: Låne 55 millioner dollar til miljøvern og vanninfrastruktur.

124.original: Condition Medicaid expansion on federal funding remaining at least 90%.
124.nb: Gjøre utvidet Medicaid-dekning avhengig av at føderale myndigheter fortsatt dekker minst 90 prosent.

125.original: Provide that "[an] individual who is not a citizen of the United States is disqualified from voting in any election or upon any question submitted to the voters".
125.nb: Fastslå at personer uten amerikansk statsborgerskap ikke kan stemme i valg eller folkeavstemninger.

126.original: Establish an unclaimed property trust fund.
126.nb: Opprette et fond for midler og eiendeler som ingen har gjort krav på.

127.original: Require a 60% supermajority by voters to approve constitutional amendments.

128.original: Remove the right to bail for specified criminal offenses.
128.nb: Fjerne retten til kausjon ved bestemte straffbare forhold.

129.original: Prohibit the legislature from enacting taxes on property.

130.original: Amend the list of crime victims' rights in the constitution.
130.nb: Endre grunnlovens liste over rettigheter for ofre for kriminalitet.

131.original: Require that constitutional amendments appearing on the ballot must be published for a period of 60 days.
131.nb: Kreve at grunnlovsendringer på stemmeseddelen offentliggjøres i 60 dager.

132.original: Require a supermajority requirement of 60% by voters for citizen-initiated ballot measures that create new taxes, increase existing tax rates, or for a property tax.
132.nb: Kreve 60 prosent flertall for borgerinitiativer som innfører eller øker skatter, eller gjelder eiendomsskatt.

133.original: Provide a state constitutional right to reproductive freedom, defined as "the right to make and effectuate one's own decisions about all matters related to one's pregnancy".
133.nb: Grunnlovsfeste reproduktiv frihet og retten til egne beslutninger om graviditet.

134.original: Repeal the provision defining marriage as between one man and one woman and prohibit the state from denying a marriage license to two adult persons based on sex, gender, or race.
134.nb: Oppheve begrensningen av ekteskap til mann og kvinne og forby avslag basert på kjønn eller rase.

135.original: Provide that persons convicted of felonies have their voting rights restored upon release from incarceration.
135.nb: Gi personer dømt for alvorlige lovbrudd stemmeretten tilbake ved løslatelse.

136.original: Establish a state constitutional right to organize or join a labor organization for the purpose of collective bargaining.
136.nb: Grunnlovsfeste retten til å organisere seg faglig for kollektive forhandlinger.

137.original: Prohibit the denial of rights to an individual based on their race, ethnicity, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or national origin.
137.nb: Forby å nekte rettigheter på grunnlag av blant annet rase, kjønn, religion, funksjonsnedsettelse eller seksuell orientering.

138.original: Re-enact Initiative to the Legislature 2081 (2024), related to parental rights to review educational materials, receive specific notifications, and opt their children out of sexual health education.
138.nb: Gjeninnføre foreldrerettigheter om innsyn i undervisningsmateriell, varsling og fritak fra seksualundervisning.

139.original: Require school and voluntary nonprofit athletics to prohibit biologically male students from competing with and against biologically female students.
139.nb: Kreve at skoleidrett og frivillig idrett utelukker biologiske gutter fra konkurranser for biologiske jenter.

140.original: Repeal the tax on household income over $1 million and prohibit state and local taxes on individual income.
140.nb: Oppheve skatten på husholdningsinntekter over én million dollar og forby lokale og delstatlige personinntektsskatter.

141.original: Prohibit the governor from using the partial veto to create or increase any tax or fee.
141.nb: Forby guvernøren å bruke delvis veto til å innføre eller øke skatter eller avgifter.

142.original: Prohibit the government from closing gatherings at places of worship during declared emergencies, including public health emergencies.
142.nb: Forby myndighetene å stenge religiøse samlinger under erklærte kriser, også helsekriser.

143.original: Prohibit the government from discriminating or granting preferential treatment based on race, sex, color, ethnicity, or national origin.
143.nb: Forby offentlig forskjellsbehandling eller særfordeler basert på rase, kjønn, hudfarge, etnisitet eller nasjonal opprinnelse.

144.original: Amend the constitution to state that only citizens may vote in elections.
144.nb: Grunnlovsfeste at bare amerikanske statsborgere kan stemme i valg.

145.original: Create a homeowner's property tax exemption that exempts 50% of a primary residence's assessed value from property taxation.
145.nb: Frita halvparten av skatteverdien av egen primærbolig fra eiendomsskatt.
